series_basis: 2019-2024 K-IFRS consolidated revenue and operating income for Korean Air and Asiana Airlines are added year by year to reconstruct the same two-airline economic perimeter before legal merger. The series ends before Korean Air's 2024-12-31 acquisition accounting; no post-acquisition reported year is mixed into training, and peer-company outcomes are excluded.

observations.calculation: (Korean Air EBIT KRW 176.086528359bn + Asiana EBIT KRW -443.7bn) / (Korean Air revenue KRW 12,384.263746893bn + Asiana revenue KRW 6,965.8bn).
(Korean Air EBIT KRW 107.324035915bn + Asiana EBIT KRW -276.4bn) / (Korean Air revenue KRW 7,610.530916271bn + Asiana revenue KRW 3,895.3bn). Korean Air's later restated comparative is used.
(Korean Air EBIT KRW 1,417.968632826bn + Asiana EBIT KRW 93.2bn) / (Korean Air revenue KRW 9,016.824640301bn + Asiana revenue KRW 4,339.7bn).
